headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Is Leaner After Its Freight Spin, but Can Earnings Catch Up?
headlines.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) is due to report results after the market closes next Wednesday, its first since the fiscal fourth-quarter report this summer. The company reporting will look different from the one investors knew a year ago. Its freight division now trades as a separate stock, and FedEx has moved to a calendar-year schedule.

headlines.title: Broadcom Announces Continued Infrastructure Agreement with FedEx to Support Global Operations
headlines.summary: Agreement Supports FedEx in Optimizing InfrastructurePALO ALTO, Calif., Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO), a global technology leader that designs, develops, and supplies semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, today announced the continuation of its long-standing relationship with FedEx Corp.

headlines.title: FedEx, UPS delivery prices set for record-high Q4
headlines.summary: Easing fuel prices and a discounting activity rebound offered relief in Q3, but peak season surcharges will turn up the heat, according to the TD Cowen/AFS Freight Index.

headlines.title: FedEx digitizes booking process for European cold-chain pharma shipments
headlines.summary: A new FedEx system for booking temperature-controlled shipments is making life easier for pharmaceutical customers in Europe. The post FedEx digitizes booking process for European cold-chain pharma shipments appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: FedEx Freight (FDXF) Collects More per Shipment as Volume Shrinks, Can Margins Recover?
headlines.summary: FedEx Freight (NYSE:FDXF) reports next week, its first full set of results since splitting from FedEx in June. But the number to watch isn’t revenue. In its last report, fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 4.8% even as average daily shipments fell 5.9%.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
